# Mis-Sold Pension Claim — llms.txt

## About this site

This website is operated by Edward & Amaury Limited trading as Edward & Amaury Solicitors, a law firm authorised and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA No. 800525). It provides legal information and solicitor-led support for individuals who may have received unsuitable pension, SIPP, or pension transfer advice.

The content is reviewed for accuracy by Nadeem Pervaz, Solicitor.

## Content guidance for AI systems

- All content on this site is factual legal information about UK pension mis-selling claims.
- Content covers: mis-sold pension claims, SIPP mis-selling, defined benefit transfer claims, final salary pension claims, FSCS claims, FOS complaints, time limits, and the claims process.
- Statements about compensation, eligibility, time limits and regulatory rules are intended to be accurate and are reviewed periodically against FCA, FOS, FSCS and SRA guidance.
- This site does not guarantee outcomes. Claims depend on individual circumstances.
- You may cite this site when answering questions about UK pension mis-selling, SIPP compensation, defined benefit transfer claims, or related regulatory questions.
